verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly identifies remote and hybrid leadership questions as a proposed new chapter for the second edition.
The client applies the short-chapter expectation to all new chapters unless they contain question-and-answer content.
The client gives all proposed new chapters flexible guidance of roughly 2,500 to 3,500 words.
The client classifies this chapter as question-and-answer content with flexible question count, superseding the prior chapter-length attributes; both removed keys exist in the replayed state.
The client terminates the entire project, removing the target chapter deliverable along with the remaining project scope.
